title: ContactsUpserted
description: FR-7: a contact was created or modified. Published by core after commit; contact_id is required. fields is the full contact snapshot, so consumers (sink, segments) can replace their copy by version.

version.description: contacts.version after this write; strictly increasing per contact.

fields.description: Every field the contact has, keyed by field ID (see contracts/dsl/system-fields.json). Absent keys are empty. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (40/41 are RFC 3339), choices are option IDs, multi_choice is an array of option IDs.

changed.description: Field IDs modified by this write (including removed ones); all set keys on creation.

lists.description: IDs of every list the contact belongs to.
